title: Huangshan, a Fantastic Place
subtitle: 考点：描写风景 / especially / take one's breath away
passage: Huangshan, or the Yellow Mountain, is in Anhui Province. It is famous for its strange rocks, old pine trees and the sea of clouds. Every year, thousands of people visit it, especially in autumn.

Li Na climbed Huangshan with her cousin last October. They got up at four in the morning because they wanted to see the sunrise. It was cold, so they wore thick coats. When the sun came up, the sky turned red and gold, and the clouds looked like a white sea below them.
On the way down, they saw the Guest-Greeting Pine. Li Na took many photos of it. She was tired but happy. She said, “The scenery here is so beautiful that it takes my breath away.”
